description_en: Queries a list of databases in an instance, cluster, or data catalog in Data Map. For DLF or StarRocks data sources, you can call this API operation to query databases in a data catalog. For StarRocks data sources, you can call this API operation to query databases in internal catalogs. For other types of data sources, you can call this API operation to query databases in an instance or cluster
description_zh:
查询数据地图中给定实例/集群/数据目录下的数据库列表。
对于dlf/starrocks类型，查询给定数据目录下的数据库列表，其中starocks类型仅支持查询Internal Catalog；
对于其他类型，查询给定实例/集群下的数据库列表
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public list-databases --parent-meta-entity-id holo:instance_id --name test_tbl --comment test_comment --sort-by CreateTime --order Asc --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDatabases

parameters.help_en:
The parent entity ID. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2880092.html.

You can refer to the ListCrawlerTypes operation for the parent entity type.

- If the parent entity is a catalog, the format of `ParentMetaEntityId` follows the response of the ListCatalogs API.

- If the parent entity is a metadata crawler, the format of `ParentMetaEntityId` is `${CrawlerType}:${Instance ID or encoded URL}`.

ParentMetaEntityId format examples

- `dlf-catalog::catalog_id`

- `holo:instance_id`

- `mysql:(instance_id|encoded_jdbc_url)`

>

- `catalog_id`: The ID of the DLF catalog.

- `instance_id`: The instance ID. Required when the data source is registered in instance mode.

- `encoded_jdbc_url`: The URL-encoded JDBC connection string. Required when the data source is registered by connection string
parameters.help_zh:
父层级实体ID，可参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2880092.html。

父层级实体类型参考ListCrawlerTypes接口

- 若父层级实体为数据目录，`ParentMetaEntityId`格式参考ListCatalogs接口返回结果。

- 如果父层级实体为元数据采集器，`ParentMetaEntityId`格式为`${CrawlerType}:${实例ID或转义后的URL}`。

几种常用类型的ParentMetaEntityId格式参考如下：

- `dlf-catalog::catalog_id`

- `holo:instance_id`

- `mysql:(instance_id|encoded_jdbc_url)`

> 其中  
- `catalog_id`: dlf目录id。
- `instance_id`: 实例ID，对应数据源以实例模式注册时需要提供。
- `encoded_jdbc_url`: JDBC连接串的URLEncode编码,对应数据源以连接串方式注册时需要提供
